subject: Exec Readyroom: Renewal risk lanes & QBR prep for Oriental Tech
messages:
From: Priyom Das <pri@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Kline <ben.k@orientaltech.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec Readyroom: Renewal risk lanes & QBR prep for Oriental Tech

Team —

Attached is the latest prep pack for Oriental Tech's QBR next week (deck + renewal risk register). The account is on a tight renewal window (EOM July) and there are three risk lanes I want exec visibility on:

1) Pricing/discount requests from procurement (they sign on a committed seat model)
2) Stability incidents last quarter impacting nightly batch jobs (some latency spikes)
3) Feature parity ask re: streaming batching API for their inference workloads

Action items: please review the risk register and add an "exec attention" flag where you think escalation is necessary. Specific asks:
- Laura: recommend which exec(s) to allocate for the pricing exception if needed.
- Grace: confirm health metrics & CS remediation timeline; any customer acceptance blockers?
- Rishi: add suggested mitigation owners and a playbook for canary rollback if stability regresses during QBR follow-ups.

Timeline: I need all flags and brief notes by 3pm PT today so I can synthesize an exec-ready 1-page for the QBR.

Attachments: oriental_qbr_prep_deck_v3.pdf (deck, 18 slides), renewal_risk_register.csv (current risks, scoring)

Thanks —
Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <pri@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Kline <ben.k@orientaltech.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec Readyroom: Renewal risk lanes & QBR prep for Oriental Tech

Priyom —

Thanks for the packet. Quick notes after a pass through the register:

- Pricing lane: procurement has already signaled they expect a multi-quarter TCV discount; elevate to exec only if the customer requests >25% net concession or asks for a multi-year price floor. Otherwise handle via sales-led concessions.
- Stability lane: put a "High" exec flag. The nightly spikes (May 12 & May 28 incidents) are visible in the SLIs and the CS workaround is a cold-restart manual step — not sustainable. Recommend we ask VP Eng to join the QBR to commit to an SLO timeline and to own the postmortem.
- Feature parity: Medium risk. We can offer a staged delivery plan; engineering would need a product spec and a pilot lane. Not an immediate exec pull unless the customer ties renewal to streaming support.

I propose the following execs for outreach: VP Sales (discount authority), VP Eng (stability), Head of Product (feature roadmap). If you want I can loop in all three as "optionally aware" and only pull them into the QBR if the customer pushes pricing/stability.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success (Interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Kline <ben.k@orientaltech.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec Readyroom: Renewal risk lanes & QBR prep for Oriental Tech

Priyom —

Appreciate the transparency and the prep materials. A few clarifications from our side:

- Procurement: our procurement team (procurement@orientaltech.com) will likely ask for a 20% discount baseline; we are not planning to request more than that right now.
- Stability: the nightly job latency is a blocker for one of our revenue reports. Grace's team has been responsive but we need a firm SLO and a timeline — ideally a fix in the next 6 weeks.
- Feature ask: streaming batching is a nice-to-have for our real-time pipeline but not a deal-breaker for the upcoming renewal. We can pilot a workaround for Q4 if needed.

Availability: We can do the QBR Tues June 15 or Wed June 16, midday PT. If VP Eng needs to join, Wed 16 is better.

Thanks —
Ben Kline
Director, Data Platforms
Oriental Tech

From: Priyom Das <pri@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Kline <ben.k@orientaltech.com>, procurement@orientaltech.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec Readyroom: Renewal risk lanes & QBR prep for Oriental Tech

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Quick synthesis for the 1-page exec-ready brief:

- Exec flags: Stability (HIGH) -> request VP Eng presence; Pricing (LOW-MED) -> procurement indicating ~20% baseline; Feature parity (MED) -> product pilot, no exec needed now.
- Next steps (owners):
  * Grace: confirm remediation SLO and provide (A) proposed patch ETA and (B) short-term mitigation steps by EOD tomorrow.
  * Rishi: draft a one-paragraph mitigation playbook for the QBR (canary rollback + prefix caching) and add owners in the register.
  * Laura: prepare an executive outreach note to VP Eng and VP Sales (subject: Oriental Tech QBR — potential stability escalation).

I'll fold these into an exec one-pager and send to leadership by 11am PT tomorrow. Ben — thanks for the availability; we'll propose Wed June 16 at 11:30am PT for the QBR and include VP Eng as optional.

Attachments referenced above.

--
Priyom Das
Account Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
